rows.quote: In all exome-wide analyses, variants were oriented to the protein-increasing allele and exGS were calculated by summing the number of independent (clumping r2 < 0.05, 10,000KB) protein-increasing alleles, weighted by betas reported in Dhindsa et al., and projected in up to 337,543 European UK Biobank participants with exome-sequencing (Supplementary Data 10) using PLINK252.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: European UK Biobank participants with exome-sequencing
rows.coder_note: Outcome associations are computed by the authors in individual-level UK Biobank participants with exome sequencing; no candidate row (all are published GWAS releases) is that dataset.

The attributing sentence (p036) cites a preprint entry whose DOI is not the candidate row's source identifier and gives a sample size that differs from the row's; the sentence carries no year, release or accession, so no row is identified. Screen row reread; stays unresolved.
